resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Italian source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Italian pass identified 25 actionable formula, terminology, grammar, technical-clarity, and SI-unit defects across electrical, circuit, thermal, trigonometric, and unit content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Italian human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The resistance rearrangement used compressed division notation.
evidence: The previous expression was R = V/I.
findings.resolution: Restored the readable protected notation R = V / I.

findings.summary: The current definition omitted the variable name and repeated ampere awkwardly.
evidence: The previous bullet said only that current was expressed in amperes.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as I è la corrente, misurata in ampere (A).

findings.summary: The practical-heating paragraph mixed infinitive and imperative forms and used an awkward literal rendering.
evidence: The previous paragraph began with Verificare and used a less natural margin phrase.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with consistent informal imperative wording and clearer thermal caution.

findings.summary: The branch definition was missing the preposition needed for natural Italian.
evidence: The previous text used percorso corrente.
findings.resolution: Changed it to percorso per la corrente.

findings.summary: The loop definition used an English loanword in an otherwise Italian list.
evidence: The previous bullet began with Un loop.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a closed path returning to its starting point.

findings.summary: The series-resistor conclusion used resistori inconsistently with the rest of the Italian terminology.
evidence: The previous conclusion referred to both components as resistori.
findings.resolution: Changed it to entrambe le resistenze.

findings.summary: The parallel-resistor conclusion used an awkward literal phrase for branch current.
evidence: The previous wording said each branch trasporta 10 A.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as each branch conducts 10 A when branch resistances are equal.

findings.summary: The voltage-law heading was less natural than the standard Italian technical form.
evidence: The previous title used Legge di Kirchhoff sulla tensione.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Legge della tensione di Kirchhoff.

findings.summary: The voltage-law paragraph used an awkward translation of loop direction and current flow.
evidence: The previous paragraph referred to una direzione del circuito and scorre attraverso.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with verso di percorrenza and attraversa terminology.

findings.summary: The cell-current bullet used a literal translation of current sharing.
evidence: The previous text began with La condivisione della corrente.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural La ripartizione della corrente.

findings.summary: The lithium-ion series-charging warning used awkward word order and omitted explicit per-cell monitoring.
evidence: The previous text said ricarica in serie agli ioni di litio.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as series charging of lithium-ion cells with monitoring of each cell.

findings.summary: The circuit-solving checklist used an impersonal infinitive where the surrounding instructions used direct imperatives.
evidence: The previous bullet began with Contrassegnare.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the direct imperative Segna.

findings.summary: The second circuit-solving checklist item had the same inconsistent mood.
evidence: The previous bullet began with Applicare.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the direct imperative Applica.

findings.summary: The model-limits paragraph switched to an impersonal infinitive at the warning conclusion.
evidence: The previous sentence ended with Includere ogni comportamento omesso.
findings.resolution: Changed it to direct imperative wording with clearer high-current context.

findings.summary: The TCR display name omitted the standard abbreviation and was less explicit about resistance.
evidence: The previous display name was only Coefficiente di temperatura della resistenza.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Coefficiente di temperatura della resistenza (TCR).

findings.summary: The TCR power paragraph used fonte di corrente and a literal driven-at-voltage phrase.
evidence: The previous paragraph was understandable but less idiomatic for an engineering explanation.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with alimentata a tensione costante and sorgente di corrente.

findings.summary: The triangle-solving heading was an awkward literal translation.
evidence: The previous title did not use the natural infinitive construction for finding sides and angles.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Trovare lati e angoli.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating setup used an ambiguous reference to the example.
evidence: The previous text began with Riscalda l'esempio da 41,8 kJ.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as heating a sample requiring 41,8 kJ with a constant 100 W source and no losses.

findings.summary: The phase-change heading did not express the practical-limit context naturally.
evidence: The previous title was a literal translation of phase changes and limits.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Cambiamenti di fase e limiti pratici.

findings.summary: The SI length row used an uppercase metre symbol.
evidence: The previous row used M instead of the SI symbol m.
findings.resolution: Corrected the row to metro with symbol m.

findings.summary: The SI time row used an uppercase second symbol.
evidence: The previous row used S instead of the SI symbol s.
findings.resolution: Corrected the row to secondo with symbol s.

findings.summary: The SI electric-current row contained a corrupted unit symbol.
evidence: The previous row used UN instead of A.
findings.resolution: Corrected the row to ampere with symbol A.

findings.summary: The amount-of-substance row translated mole as neo.
evidence: The previous row used the unrelated Italian word neo.
findings.resolution: Changed the unit name to mole and retained mol.

findings.summary: The SI luminous-intensity row used an uppercase candela symbol.
evidence: The previous row used CD instead of cd.
findings.resolution: Corrected the row to candela with symbol cd.

findings.summary: The milli prefix used the uppercase mega symbol.
evidence: The previous row used M for 10^-3.
findings.resolution: Corrected the prefix row to milli with symbol m.
